problemStatement.formal: Let $x/2 < y < x$ and $C > 1$. If $d = \max_{p_n < x}(p_{n+1} - p_n)$, then is $\pi(y + Cd) - \pi(y) \sim \frac{Cd}{\log y}$?
problemStatement.plain: Does the count of primes in (y, y+Cd] follow the expected asymptotic when d is the maximal prime gap?

proven: Formalized prime counting and maximal prime gap
knownResults.goal: Show primes distribute normally in intervals of length proportional to maximal gap

blockers: Even under RH intervals too short for PNT

knowledge.progressSummary: Created Lean formalization with prime counting and maximal gap. Proved basic properties.
insights: Gap d ~ (log x)^2 far below any proven short interval PNT range
Doubly hard: gap estimates AND short interval methods
